title: Longest stretch without a repeated character
summary: Watch passengers board through a train window and find the longest run of neighbours in which no badge repeats.
goal: Find the longest run of neighbouring passengers with no badge repeated

mapping.story: Where each badge was last seen

examples.label: abcabcbb
examples.explanation: The longest runs are abc, bca and cab, each 3 long.

examples.label: bbbbb
examples.explanation: Every run longer than one repeats b.

examples.label: abba
examples.explanation: ab and ba both have length 2. The second a's earlier twin is no longer in the window.

ladder.name: Check every stretch
ladder.idea: For every start and end, check whether the stretch has a repeat, and keep the longest without one.

ladder.name: Slide a window with a set
ladder.idea: Grow the window on the right. When the new badge is already inside, remove badges from the left one at a time until it is gone.
ladder.insight: A stretch with a repeat stays bad if you extend it, so there is no need to restart: keep a window and shrink it only as far as needed.

ladder.name: Jump with last-seen positions
ladder.idea: Remember where each badge was last seen. When a badge repeats inside the window, move the left edge straight past its previous position.
ladder.insight: The set version removes badges one by one, but we already know where the earlier twin sits. Remembering positions lets the left edge jump there in one step.

approaches.name: Jump with last-seen positions
approaches.summary: Grow on the right; jump the left edge past a repeat's previous position.

transfer.problem: A playlist must not play the same artist twice in a row of consecutive songs. Find the longest stretch of the queue with no artist repeated.
transfer.explanation: It asks for the longest run of consecutive items with no repeats: grow a window and move its left edge past each repeated artist.

selfCheck: Only jumps the left edge when the earlier twin is inside the window.
Never moves the left edge backwards.
Updates the last-seen position on every step.
